column1:
THE LIVE FREE PAINTING COMPETITION WAS CONDUCTED IN
2017 ACROSS THE REGION KENYA, UGANDA AND TANZANIA
WITH THE AIM OF GIVING PUPILS AN OPPORTUNITY TO SHARE
THEIR VISION ON WHAT LIVING FREE MEANS TO THEM IN THE
FORM OF ART.

column2:
WE REWARDED THE WINNERS WITH FULL
SECONDARY SCHOOL SCHOLARSHIPS AND
THEIR SCHOOLS RECEIVED AN ASSORTMENT
OF BOOKS & SPORTS EQUIPMENT.
KENYA 25 NATIONAL WINNERS, TANZANIA 5
NATIONAL WINNERS, UGANDA 3 NATIONAL
WINNERS.
